glyph_rationales.Venus: the goddess who receives displaced worship as affront and sets the punishment in motion (#0); her participation changed at the feast, no confession narrated (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.Cupid: sent to punish, becoming the unseen husband — named only to fly wounded to the cypress after the lamp (#0, #2).

glyph_rationales.⚠⚠: the warning repeated: the child divine if the secret is kept, mortal if betrayed (#1).
glyph_rationales.☀: the lamp opened — the seeing that discovers something true: the husband is Cupid (#2).
glyph_rationales.•: the drop of hot oil on his right shoulder — the lamp's own desire, the wound that separates (#2).
glyph_rationales.↥: the arrow-prick — she falls more deeply in love with Love by her own wound (#2; the waking at #4 is a prick, against modern-kiss substitutions).
glyph_rationales.◉: the scald — the red mark where the oil struck; he wakes in pain and flies (#2).
glyph_rationales.ΠΑ: Pan with Echo — counsel against suicide: appeal rather than die (#2).
